verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Marketing Emails API for creating, updating, retrieving, and getting post-send statistics on marketing emails, plus UI-based segment sends and scheduling. Nothing in the pack shows an API for one-to-one transactional sends such as receipts, magic links, or notifications. Managing marketing email objects is an adjacent capability, not transactional sending, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send one-to-one transactional email — receipts, magic links, notifications — through the same platform's API alongside marketing sends
